implementation: Retry failed application only against the exact old/new recorded local blob in a private workspace; reverse, literal rename paths, original policy/modes and current snapshots retained. No guessed HEAD or remote fetch.
Initial per-file ready/conflict/error classification, full-check fast path and exclusion of already-completed paths. Conflict is the source recovered-base flag, not a fabricated hunk count.
An initially applicable review refuses later conflicts until Refresh; save validates actual captured current bytes/modes/paths. Unsafe aliases/.git/traversal retain explicit path refusal.
Embedded existing Subversion three-pane beside file list; native Merge toolbar shared through a model/window owner adapter. Captions distinguish current and patched base; index resolution disabled.
Guarded existing edited-result save, current encoding, optional new-file Add, clean completed preview/history reset, original zero-line PatchSave deletion semantics. Source patch remains immutable.
Patch all/selected use existing direct application or save a clean three-way recovery without staging. Conflicting/ignored results remain unwritten; later files continue.
Parent dirty/Close/Quit/export/operation gates, owned tokens, retained grants and forced-retirement fences connected to the embedded editor.
